parse.title: Events
parse.wikitext:
There are currently two world events, plus a recurring weekend event.

== Blood Moon ==
The Blood Moon is the main world event to look out for. The timing of Blood Moons is unknown, but several hours can pass between one and the next. During a Blood Moon, all Werewolves and Vampires are significantly stronger, including werewolf NPCs. You also gain more EXP from killing NPCs during a Blood Moon. During a Blood Moon, NPCs become hostile toward players and may attack them.

== Foggy Night ==
The Foggy Night contributes little except that it is extremely hard to see.

== 2x XP Weekend ==
The 2x XP weekend event starts every Friday. XP boosts last 30 minutes each, are purchased or obtained by using codes, and stack with the weekend event:
* 2x XP — 295 Robux (266 with Plus)
* 3x XP — 495 Robux (446 with Plus)
* 4x XP — 795 Robux (716 with Plus)
